title: Playable title screen globe in my driving game
author: Fabulous-Pin-5681
selftext:
I used Astra to build a playable title screen on my low poly driving game, All Roads  
  
Demo here if you want to try it out: [ALL ROADS](https://allroads.game/)

Clicking the title goes to the playable area but you can drag around the edges of the globe to look at it too. Press "F" to toggle free mode to drive off the roads and "R" to reset  
  
Only needed a few prompts to finalize it, maybe took about 20 minutes. I was really impressed by how closely this fit my description following the crude hand drawing I made for reference.  I wanted it to be actual Earth but just shrunk down to scale and with landmarks/cities for a lived-in feel. Plus some crazy space roads twisting over the planet for a gimmicky wow-factor lol.   
  
Open to feedback! Any features you'd want to see? Or maybe it's too much/too busy? Eventually I want to add a day/night cycle and more landmarks on the surface
